Three hundred years ago, the tower's light began to dim. To claim the remaining light, the eight races turned their blades on one another. Dragonkin fire swallowed the World Tree, the dead of the Ashen Mausoleum raised the battlefield's corpses, and in a duel on the red sands the orc Khan fell spitting black blood. The sky was covered in ash, and the island saw no sun for seven years

Three hundred years passed. Lately, every night the light atop the tower beats like a heart. Nameless monsters crawl from the ground beneath it, and long-dormant engravings grow hot again. In Windward Village, where those belonging to no race gather, a climber looks up at the tower
